item.title: Psalm 5: Beginning the Day with Prayer and God-Centered Clarity
item.description: Psalm 5 shows how to begin the day with prayer, dependence on God, and righteous living. Dave Jenkins explains how a God-centered morning forms a God-dependent day and points listeners to Christ as our refuge and righteous King.

item.title: Why Manifestation and the Law of Attraction Contradict Biblical Truth
item.description: New Age concepts such as manifestation, energy, vibration, and the law of attraction contradict biblical truth. This episode explains why these teachings shift trust away from God and undermine biblical dependence on Christ.

item.title: Psalm 6: God Hears the Cries of the Brokenhearted
item.description: Psalm 6 is the first of the penitential psalms—a prayer of confession, sorrow, and hope in the steadfast love of God. Dave Jenkins explains how God hears the cries of the brokenhearted and why lament is faith crying out to the God who forgives and delivers.

item.title: Counterfeit Spirituality and False Revival: Why Discernment Still Matters
item.description: In this episode of The Weekly Watch, part of the Contending for the Word podcast, Dave Jenkins examines the rise of counterfeit spirituality, false revival language, and experience-driven teachings that subtly shift authority away from Scripture. Instead of reacting with speculation or outrage, this episode calls believers to biblical discernment grounded in the sufficiency, clarity, and authority of God’s Word.

item.title: Discipling Children Biblically: Five Gospel-Centered Commitments for Parents
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins addresses one of the most important callings God has given to Christian parents: discipling their children according to the Word of God. Drawing from Deuteronomy 6:6–7, Dave explains that biblical discipleship does not begin in the teenage years, nor is it outsourced to the church, school, or culture. item.title: Psalm 7 Explained: Trusting God’s Justice When You Are Falsely Accused
item.description: Psalm 7 is a prayer for justice in the face of false accusation, slander, and oppression. In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 7 and shows how God’s people are called to respond when their integrity is questioned and they are treated unjustly. Rather than seeking revenge, David entrusts himself to the Lord—the righteous Judge of all the earth.
